/**
 * @name Identify File System and Command Execution
 * @description Find all file system accesses and command executions to understand package behavior.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/file-and-command-audit
 * @tags security
 *       audit
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("open").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("popen").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("importlib.resources").getMember(["path", "read_text", "read_binary", "open_text", "open_binary"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pkg_resources").getMember(["resource_filename", "resource_string", "resource_stream"]).getACall()
select call, "File system or command execution detected."
findings.hypothesis: The package might access files or execute commands in an insecure way.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous Function Use in Library
 * @description Checks for use of dangerous functions like exec, eval, or subprocess in the library code.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/certifi-dangerous-functions
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 *       external/cwe/cwe-095
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string name
where
  (
    (
      call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() and name = "exec"
    ) or
    (
      call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() and name = "eval"
    ) or
    (
      call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() and name = "subprocess"
    ) or
    (
      call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "spawn"]).getACall() and name = "os.system/popen"
    )
  )
  and not call.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "setup.py"
  and not call.getLocation().getFile().getShortName().matches("test%")
select call, "Call to dangerous function " + name + " in library code."
findings.hypothesis: Checks for any usage of dangerous functions (exec, eval, subprocess) within the certifi library code (runtime), excluding setup.py. This verifies that the library does not perform unexpected code or command execution.
